metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_mean_offdiagonal: Raw mean off-diagonal cosine over up to 2048 uniformly sampled real-item rows, seed 42; computed in float64 after excluding nonfinite rows or norms<=1e-12. Uses (||sum(unit_rows)||^2-N)/(N*(N-1)); requires N>=2. Directional similarity, not a calibrated collapse probability or evidence of HR failure.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score over finite nonpadding sequence/positive/negative positions.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of those margins; null when no valid positions exist.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid margins below zero.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid margins below eps=0.5; score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Item categories unavailable; category lists intentionally empty. Position counts remain measured.

Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.selection: Sorted string user IDs, seed-42 permutation; select at most 200 structurally eligible training users per category before inspecting scores. Nonfinite scoring cases are recorded without replacement and excluded from paired estimates; report selected and scored counts separately. Last training item is target; preceding history truncated once to model.maxlen. Requires at least three items.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.scope: All prefix results are in-sample: fitting may already have used the reserved target. Earlier target occurrences remain and are flagged. No validation reproduction without exact authorized host candidates.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.conditions: n=bounded length; k=min(5,(n-1)//2). Intact=history; suffix=last min(10,n); recent deletion=history[:n-1-k]+history[-1:]; old deletion=history[k:]; anchor deletion=history[:-1]. No backfill. Recent/old remove equal counts and preserve anchor; suffix is descriptive, and unchanged suffixes are unaffected. Anchor deletion changes readout item.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.geometry: Left-pad each retained history and read greatest nonzero index. Compaction changes absolute positions and evidence jointly. Faithful geometry-preserving masking unavailable. Existing attention normalization remains fixed. Original aligned timestamps are recorded; this HSTU has no temporal input.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.candidates: 99 unique uniform real-item negatives without replacement, excluding every training item, padding and reserved IDs. Identical 100 candidates across conditions. Rank=1+preceding count under descending score, ascending item ID ties; this diagnostic tie rule is not a claim about host ties.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.effects: Hit=rank<=10; delta_rank=perturbed-intact rank; delta_hr=perturbed-intact hit. Top10 overlap=intersection with intact top10 divided by 10. All paired estimates use identical eligible users.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.uncertainty: 2000 paired user bootstrap replicates, seed 42, same user indices across conditions; percentile 95% intervals. Conditional on fitted model, selected users and fixed candidates; excludes training-seed/candidate variation and repeated-selection optimism.
Movies_and_TV:paired_recent_context.macro: aggregate_categories accepts four explicitly identified reports from this trial, resamples within each category and equally averages category means. Missing or empty categories yield unavailable, never zero imputation. Single-view reports contain no purported macro estimate.
